package.description: A freeware BASIC-like scripting language designed for automating the Windows GUI and general scripting.

en-US.description: A freeware BASIC-like scripting language designed for automating the Windows GUI and general scripting.
en-US.longDescription:
AutoIt v3 is a freeware BASIC-like scripting language designed for automating the Windows GUI and general scripting. It uses a combination of simulated keystrokes, mouse movement and window/control manipulation in order to automate tasks in a way not possible or reliable with other languages (e.g. VBScript and SendKeys). AutoIt is also very small, self-contained and will run on all versions of Windows out-of-the-box with no annoying "runtimes" required!
AutoIt was initially designed for PC "roll out" situations to reliably automate and configure thousands of PCs. Over time it has become a powerful language that supports complex expressions, user functions, loops and everything else that veteran scripters would expect. Features:
- Easy to learn BASIC-like syntax
- Simulate keystrokes and mouse movements
- Manipulate windows and processes
- Interact with all standard windows controls
- Scripts can be compiled into standalone executables
- Create Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs)
- COM support
- Regular expressions
- Directly call external DLL and Windows API functions
- Scriptable RunAs functions
- Detailed helpfile and large community-based support forums
- Compatible with Windows XP SP3 / 2003 SP2 / Vista / 2008 / Windows 7 / 2008 R2 / Windows 8 / 2012 R2
- Unicode and x64 support
- Digitally signed for peace of mind
- Works with Windows User Account Control (UAC)
AutoIt has been designed to be as small as possible and stand-alone with no external .dll files or registry entries required making it safe to use on Servers. Scripts can be compiled into stand-alone executables with Aut2Exe.
Also supplied is a combined COM and DLL version of AutoIt called AutoItX that allows you to add the unique features of AutoIt to your own favorite scripting or programming languages!
en-US.name: AutoIt

zh-CN.description: 一款类似 BASIC 的用于自动化 Windows 图形用户界面和普通脚本的脚本语言
zh-CN.longDescription:
AutoIt v3 是一款类似 BASIC 的免费脚本语言，用于自动化 Windows 图形用户界面和普通脚本。它通过组合模拟击键、鼠标移动和窗口/控件操作，以其它语言（如 VBScript 和 SendKeys）无法实现或不能可靠实现的方式自动执行任务。此外，AutoIt 非常小巧，自成一体，开箱即可在所有版本的 Windows 上运行，无需恼人的“运行时”！
AutoIt 最初是为 PC 爆发的情况而设计的，目的是可靠地自动配置成千上万台 PC。随着时间的推移，它已成为一种功能强大的语言，支持复杂的表达式、用户函数、循环以及资深脚本编写者所期望的一切功能。特点包括：
- 类似 BASIC 的语法，简单易学
- 模拟击键和鼠标移动
- 操纵窗口和进程
- 与所有标准窗口控件交互
- 脚本可编译成独立的可执行文件
- 创建图形用户界面（GUI）
- 支持 COM
- 正则表达式
- 直接调用外部 DLL 和 Windows API 函数
- 脚本运行函数
- 详细的帮助文件和大型社区支持论坛
- 与 Windows XP SP3 / 2003 SP2 / Vista / 2008 / Windows 7 / 2008 R2 / Windows 8 / 2012 R2 兼容
- 支持 Unicode 和 x64
- 数字签名，可放心使用
- 可与 Windows 用户帐户控制 (UAC) 协同工作
AutoIt 的设计尽可能小巧、独立，不需要外部 .dll 文件或注册表项，因此可在服务器上安全使用。脚本可通过 Aut2Exe 编译成独立的可执行文件。
此外，AutoIt 还提供了一个名为 AutoItX 的 COM 和 DLL 结合版本，允许您将 AutoIt 的独特功能添加到自己喜欢的脚本或编程语言中！
